info.title: n-doc web API
info.description: REST adapter of the n-doc core. Errors are `ErrorBody` objects (`code`, `message`, `details`). Every request except login and health needs the `ndoc_session` cookie; state-changing requests also need the `X-CSRF-Token` header (value of the `ndoc_csrf` cookie).

post.description:
Check the credentials and start a session (cookies ``ndoc_session``,
HttpOnly, and ``ndoc_csrf``, to be echoed in ``X-CSRF-Token``).
Change the own password; other sessions of the user end.

patch.description:
Change role, password or disabled. The last active admin cannot be
demoted or disabled (409 ``last_admin``).

get.description: The n-doc documents (``PDF_DIRS``, plus ``mwe_*`` test documents).
The ``\input`` tree of a document, starting at its main file.
A text file with its ``sha256`` (send it back as ``expected_sha256``).

put.description:
Write a whole file atomically. 409 ``stale_write`` (with ``current_hash``)
when it changed since it was read. Returns the check results of the saved
file (LaTeX syntax + references; key/FK checks for ``common/db`` CSV).

get.description: Reference macros (``\sfrlink`` -> ``sfr``, ...) and the valid keys per kind.

post.description: Static checks without changing anything (allowed for every role).

get.description:
Tables with CSV path, columns (header order), primary key and foreign
keys (composite ones included).
All rows (with their file line) and the file's ``sha256``.

put.description:
Change columns of the one row matching ``match``. A key other rows
reference cannot change (409 ``row_referenced``): use rename-key.

delete.description:
Delete the one row matching ``match``. 409 ``row_referenced`` (details
``referenced_by``) while other rows reference it.

get.description:
Allowed values of ``table.column``: for a foreign key column the
referenced rows (``key`` holds the full, possibly composite key).

post.description:
Rename a row's key and every CSV row referencing it in one atomic write;
``tex_references`` lists the .tex references to update.

get.description:
Every target ``POST /api/build/{target}`` accepts (aliases such as
``tds``, ``st``, ``delivery`` and document directories).

post.description:
Start a build in the background; poll ``GET /api/build/latest``.
409 ``build_busy`` while another build runs.

get.description: State of the latest build; ``log_tail`` grows while it runs.
The built PDF of a document (inline). 404 ``not_found`` if not built yet.

BuildStatus.title: BuildStatus
BuildStatus.description:
The latest build of this server. ``log_tail`` grows while running;
``error`` is set when the build could not run (e.g. Docker missing).

ChecksRequest.title: ChecksRequest
ChecksRequest.description:
Scope: ``paths``, or a whole ``document``, or (neither) the files changed
in the working tree. ``sfr_consistency`` defaults to "when CSV data is in
scope"; ``pdfs`` scans built PDFs.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description:
Every error response. ``code`` is stable (core error codes plus
``unauthenticated``, ``forbidden``, ``csrf_failed``, ``invalid_credentials``,
``too_many_attempts``, ``invalid_request``, ``last_admin``).

FileWrite.title: FileWrite
FileWrite.description:
Existing file: ``expected_sha256`` (from the read) must match. New file:
``create=true`` (the directory must exist).

References.title: References
References.description: Editor completion: reference macro -> kind, kind -> valid keys.

RowUpdate.title: RowUpdate
RowUpdate.description: ``match``: the primary key (or the whole row for tables without one).
